summary.text: Heaven and Earth Song is a sound path killer move Feng Jiu Ge created. It borrows the strength of heaven and earth and uses that might to suppress resistance.

claims.text: At Luo Po Valley, facing Qin Bai Sheng’s five finger fist heart sword, Feng Jiu Ge names the song. During cultivation he discovered heaven and earth, faced them, and revered them, feeling nature’s vastness and his own weakness. He sets the song against that sword stance as opposite paths: boundless force in accordance with nature, versus defying heaven’s will alone.

Qin Bai Sheng says the self-created song could match five finger fist heart sword. When Feng Jiu Ge sings it, his voice is grand and magnificent and makes others feel their own insignificance, unlike green jade song’s crisp jade-bead sharpness.
Among Feng Jiu Ge’s three trump cards it sits first, before green jade song and submission song. The three are powerful, grand, profound, and mystical.

Chasing Fang Yuan’s group into anti-sound desert, Feng Jiu Ge casts it and the world sings. The immortals feel the sky tall and the earth wide, and feel themselves becoming ants and dust. Gu Immortals and their immortal killer moves are influenced. Suppressed moves become weaker and dissipate after a few breaths of time. Qin Bai Sheng’s group suffered from it at Luo Po Valley. Reverse flow protection seal is unmoved, shows only some ripples, and reflects a portion of the power back to Feng Jiu Ge, who tastes his own killer move for the first time.

Through song warrior the move becomes a heaven and earth song warrior with the power of suppression. It attacks Bai Ning Bing, then fights Ying Wu Xie and Fairy Miao Yin evenly. Among four offensive songs it stands with green jade song, submission song, and separation song.
Myriad dragon later eats that warrior among too many dragons.
Still in that chase Feng Jiu Ge unleashes it as his second song warrior, named Heaven and Earth Song Warrior, while dodging with yang pass tune and summoning song warriors.

There the song is loud and clear, resonates with heaven and earth, draws out that might, pressures minds, and can weaken enemy attacks. It is weaker in Lang Ya blessed land, because that heaven and earth belongs to Feng Jiu Ge’s enemy and will not lend him its power.
Among seven songs then held, it is a trump card reserved for major fights, with green jade song, submission song, and separation song.
Inside yama battlefield Feng Jiu Ge activates song warrior with this song among four. Heaven and earth song has little effect there.
